(i) the number of cells subject to disclosure is proportional to the number of rows or columns in the contingency table; (ii) there is a threshold number of rows or column for each type of disclosure; if the number of rows (or columns) in the contingency table is smaller than the threshold, no cells are subject to disclosure; and (iii) the threshold is different for different types of disclosure.
